design_condition: The building is pushed into the southern green space, extends the schoolyard access axis, and creates a passage linking the schoolyard with the southern path network.

positive.statement: The project achieves its high design goals with precisely formulated proportions.
It enters into dialogue with the existing buildings without losing its independence or disrupting the desired ensemble.
The design towards the schoolyard is good and sensitively developed.
The primary-school and textile-design rooms are spatially well organized and benefit from the spacious terrace.

negative.statement: The vertical sun-protection slats towards the south seem strange and contrast with the otherwise appropriate design.
The nested building envelope is relatively extensive, burdening the grey-energy balance and only barely meeting the stated requirements.
The rigid geometric concept of the themed gardens raises questions about its appropriateness.
The new north-south axis appears very dominant, while the bicycle-parking arrangement is incomprehensible.
The strict design of the school garden does not seem child-friendly.
The desired division into different day-school areas is only unclearly visible.
The access situation for the underground technical-design rooms is unclear.
The decision not to orient entrances towards the schoolyard is surprising, while the south facade is unwelcoming and undifferentiated.
